title: Data Scientist - Price
description:
When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! By comparing prices from major booking sites, we're making it easy for people to find hotels they want at a price they'll love. In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry. A career at trivago is a journey designed for people who crave continuous development and want to thrive in a high\-performing team. Here you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!


### **Join us in making a difference**



Join our Price team, where your expertise will shape algorithms impacting millions of daily users across hundreds of booking sites in real time. In this pivotal role, you'll be part of a new team dedicated to designing, implementing, and enhancing our price caching algorithms, price change prediction models, and dynamic pricing strategies. You will tackle complex challenges at the intersection of experimental design, statistics, machine learning, and sequential decision analytics/dynamic optimization.  

Our team is a vital part of the Deals Product unit, whose mission is to revolutionize the deal discovery experience in the hotel search industry. You will collaborate closely with three other data science teams, product managers and engineers.  

If you have a strong background in machine learning, economics, or applied science, we invite you to apply and drive the future of data\-driven pricing innovation today!

  


### **How you'll make an impact:**


* Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, and data engineers to solve complex problems and explore new business opportunities
* Drive innovation by developing and implementing advanced data\-driven solutions that align business priorities with technical feasibility
* Establish new evaluation metrics and simulation techniques to improve the assessment of test performances and long\-term impacts
* Communicate results and insights effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

### **What you'll need to thrive:**


* 5\+ years' practical experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science roles
* Advanced academic background (MSc or PhD) in **machine learning, economics, statistics**, optimization or related fields, with a solid understanding of software engineering
* Expertise in machine learning, and specialized knowledge in time series, dynamic pricing, reinforcement learning, stochastic optimization or a related field
* Deep knowledge of statistical concepts and experience with experimental design
* Entrepreneurial mindset with an ability to thrive in a fast\-paced business environment, balancing cutting\-edge research with pragmatism for real\-world impact
* Proficient communication skills, comfortable presenting ideas and findings to varied audiences
* Expertise in Python or R (including relevant libraries), solid SQL skills, and experience with Cloud computing services

### **Stand out with:**


* Knowledge in sequential decision analytics and modeling
* Expertise in dynamic pricing strategies
* Proficiency in time series models / state\-space models
* Experience in dynamic caching technologies
* A PhD in a quantitative field


Worried about missing a few requirements? Still apply, and express your motivation as you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!


**Recruiting process for this role:**


* Video application
* Introduction call
* Case study
* Technical interview
* Collaboration interview

### **What you can look forward to:**


**As you grow, so do we.**
This is why at trivago, we prioritize your development, offer personalized coaching through Nilo, and provide workshops, educational meetups, conferences, free online learning courses, and access to a fully\-equipped campus library.

**Moving to join us?**
No problem. You can count on the visa support from our talent support team, a relocation package, interest\-free newcomer loan, free language classes, regular team and company\-wide events to build experiences together.

**Life happens.**
We offer self\-determined vacation (with a minimum of 25 vacation days), flexible working hours, 2 WFH days weekly, the chance to work remotely for 20 days abroad, free access to the Heynanny platform for personalized nanny assistance, and an on\-campus kids room.

**Enjoy your office days.**
Use your daily canteen budget to share lunch with colleagues in our canteen, help yourself to complimentary snacks and drinks in our kitchens, stay healthy with our on\-site gym and sports classes, and enjoy the comfort of ergonomic desks and focused work areas. *Thank you for considering a career at trivago! Our commitment to fostering an inclusive and enriching environment for all talents is at the heart of what we do. We understand that embarking on a new job opportunity is a blend of excitement and curiosity. Should any questions arise before you apply, feel free to reach out to us at* ***joinus@trivago.com****. Join us in our mission to make a positive impact on global travel, w**e look forward to your application!*

* Expertise im Themenfeld Küstenforschung und Klimawandel
* Selbstständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

title: Vice President, AI & Data Science
description:
**About Messagepoint**



Messagepoint is a privately\-owned software company providing an AI\-powered SaaS solution that enables enterprises to manage and personalize customer communications with greater speed, accuracy, and control. Our award\-winning platform empowers business users to create and optimize compliant, personalized communications across digital and print channels using advanced content intelligence and large language models.

  



Messagepoint is headquartered in Toronto with employees located throughout Canada, the United States



and the UK.

 **About the Role**



We're hiring a Vice President, AI \& Data Science to lead our award\-winning MARCIE AI Platform and guide a diverse team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, MLOps specialists, and platform developers. You will shape the future of generative AI for enterprise customer communications—work that directly impacts millions of communications daily across healthcare, financial services, insurance, and e\-commerce. This role combines strategic vision, technical excellence, and research leadership, reporting to our Executive Vice President, R\&D.

  



MARCIE has earned three consecutive AI Excellence Awards (2023\-2025\) and is the industry's first generative AI solution for Customer Communications Management (CCM). You'll drive platform innovation, research partnerships with leading universities, and position Messagepoint as the technical leader in enterprise AI applications.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* **Define AI s****trategy and roadmap: Set multi\-year vision for MARCIE platform evolution aligned with business objectives; guide technology stack decisions (OpenAI, Gemini, AWS Bedrock) and vendor partnerships worth $1M\+ annually**

  


* **Lead platform architecture**: Oversee multi\-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and MLOps implementation ensuring production reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency across enterprise deployments

  


* **Drive research excellence**: Manage university partnerships and academic collaborations, secure R\&D grants and tax credit programs, and guide patent development and publication programs

  


* **Build and mentor team**: Lead cross\-functional AI division spanning data scientists, AI/ML engineers, MLOps specialists, QA professionals, and platform developers; recruit top talent, establish career development frameworks, and foster collaborative, high\-performance culture

  


* **Ensure production impact**: Translate AI capabilities into measurable customer value (10x productivity gains, sub\-second response times, improved translation accuracy); support go\-to\-market and customer success initiatives

  


* **Position industry leadership**: Represent Messagepoint through conference speaking, technical publications, media engagement, and strategic thought leadership in enterprise AI space

  


* **Collaborate with executives**: Provide technical guidance to CEO and board on AI capabilities, competitive positioning, and emerging technology trends

  


**What You Bring (Must\-Haves)**

  


* **10\+ years in** **AI/ML** with proven track record deploying production LLM\-powered systems to enterprise customers at scale

  


* **5\+ years leading teams**: Demonstrated success building and scaling AI research/engineering organizations with direct reports, budget authority, and strategic planning responsibility

  


* **Advanced degree** (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field with strong foundation in deep learning, NLP, and transformer architectures

  


* **Hands\-on technical contributor**: Active coder and solution architect who develops production generative AI applications, builds RAG pipelines, implements multi\-agent orchestration systems, and writes code alongside your team; this is not a purely managerial role

  


* **Multi\-cloud expertise**: Deep understanding of AWS, GCP, or Azure infrastructure; experience with MLOps, vector databases, RAG pipelines, and API\-first design

  


* **Executive communication**: Proven ability to influence C\-suite and board\-level strategy through clear, compelling technical storytelling

  


* **Research or academic collaboration**: Experience managing university partnerships, grant programs, publications, or patent development

  


* **Work authorization**: Eligible to work in Canada; remote\-first role requires strong asynchronous communication and self\-direction

  


**Nice to Have**

  


* Publications in top AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP) or journals

  


* Experience with government R\&D grant programs and tax credits

  


* Domain expertise in Customer Communications Management (CCM), document processing, or regulated industries (healthcare, financial services, insurance)

  


* Conference speaking experience and established presence in AI research or practitioner communities

  


* Track record of 10x\+ productivity improvements through AI implementations

  


**How We Work**

  


* **Remote\-first**: Work primarily from anywhere in Canada with flexible hours, while maintaining occasional in\-office presence for collaboration, team building, and strategic planning

  


* **Collaboration tools**: Slack, Zoom, GitHub, Linear, Confluence; weekly team standups and bi\-weekly executive reviews

  


* **AI\-first culture**: Heavy use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Augment, GitHub Copilot) for maximum team productivity

  


* **Research \+ production balance**: Combine academic rigor with pragmatic engineering; publish and patent while shipping reliable enterprise systems

  


* **T****ravel**: 4\-6 times per year for conferences, customer meetings, or team offsites

  


**Our Tech Sta****ck**

  

* **LLM Provide****rs**: OpenAI (GPT\-4o), Google Gemini (2\.5 Flash), AWS Bedrock (Claude, Titan)

  


* **Agent Frameworks**: LangGraph, OpenAI Assistants, LangChain

  


* **Cloud**: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, SageMaker), GCP, Azure

  


* **Vector DBs**: pgvector, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate

  


* **Observability**: LangSmith, TruLens, DeepEval, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry

  


* **AI Safety**: Guardrails, PII detection (AWS Comprehend, Presidio), content filtering

  


* **Development**: Claude Code, Augment, GitHub Copilot, Jupyter, MLflow, PyTorch, Hugging Face

  


**To Apply:** Submit your resume and a brief cover letter describing your leadership philosophy and visionfor enterprise AI. Include links to publications, patents, or notable projects that demonstrate your expertise.

  



Messagepoint is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

  



We thank you for your interest, however, only those who qualify for an interview will be contacted.
